title: Apache Ossie Mapping Specification
description: JSON Schema for validating a standalone Apache Ossie mapping document: the constructs of one semantic model mapped onto one ontology, as its own document rather than embedded inside the ontology's ontology_mappings.

ontology.description: Reference to the ontology document this mapping targets

semantic_model.description: Reference to the semantic model document this mapping draws from

concept_mappings.description: Maps logical model constructs to some concept and its relationships in the referenced ontology

DocumentReference.description: Reference to another Ossie document by its logical name, with an iri saying where to resolve it from

name.description: Must equal the referenced document's own 'name'; carries this reference's checkable identity regardless of location

iri.description: Where to resolve the referenced document from: a relative reference (e.g. a path alongside this document) or an absolute IRI once a catalog resolves names to locations
